title: Read, write, execute
hints: Each permission is one bit, so a set of permissions is just an `unsigned` with several bits on. Combining flags is `|`; everything else is `&`, `~` or both.
Grant: `(perms | flags) & PERM_ALL`. Revoke: `perms & ~flags`. Has all: every required bit is present, i.e. `(perms & required) == required`. Has any: `(perms & wanted) != 0`.

`out[0] = (perms & PERM_READ) ? 'r' : '-';` and the same for `'w'` and `'x'`, then `out[3] = '\0';`. Note that `perm_has_all(p, 0)` is `true` (nothing is required), while `perm_has_any(p, 0)` is `false`.
